name: Wisteria seedling
notes: Navy pot at the window. Wants bright direct sun and consistently moist soil — more outdoor vine than houseplant. Will likely outgrow indoor life within a year or two.

name: Tradescantia zebrina (Office)
notes: Striped purple/green trailer, some brown dried growth — timing not confirmed.

name: Lucky Bamboo (Dracaena sanderiana)
notes: Unbraided/natural form of Lucky Bamboo — segmented cane sections with ring nodes confirm the ID. Some leaf tip browning/yellowing visible in photo, likely move stress rather than a current problem.

name: Young Dracaena (tentative)
notes: Small blue pot. Tentatively another young Dracaena — possibly a Lucky Bamboo seedling or a related cultivar like Dracaena fragrans, not fully confirmed. The tan patch is mid-blade, more likely a scuff/scrape than pest or disease. The dried crispy leaf at the base is probably just normal older-leaf dieback.

name: Golden Pothos (Office)
notes: Hand-painted red/white bug-sticker pot.

name: Monstera deliciosa (stake)
notes: On the maroon/burgundy climbing stake — the stake, not the plant, is that color.

name: Monstera 'Burle Marx Flame'
notes: Window sill above the radiator cover.

name: Monstera deliciosa (tan spot)
notes: Small tan spotted leaf, cause not yet confirmed.

name: Small 3-leaf plant
notes: 3 small heart-shaped leaves, likely Philodendron.

name: Pothos cutting (blue glass)
notes: Rooting in a blue textured glass.

name: Dark purple Tradescantia
notes: Near-black, rooting in a glass.

name: Small cutting, curled leaf
notes: One light-green heart leaf plus one curled leaf, type unconfirmed.

name: Philodendron hederaceum
notes: Freshly potted in soil. Too young to confirm ID with certainty — revisit as it matures.

name: Aglaonema 'Silver Bay'
notes: Dense silver speckling over dark green, pale midrib.

name: Venus Fly Trap
notes: Distilled/rain/RO water only, never tap. Wants several hours of real direct sun — current shelf spot may not be enough long-term. Needs winter dormancy to survive long-term.

name: Manjula-type Pothos cutting (clip)
notes: Rooting in a glass with a clip. Parent has small pre-existing holes/torn edges from how it was acquired, not pest damage.

name: Manjula-type Pothos cutting (shot glass)
notes: Rooting in water in a shot glass.

name: Croton 'Mrs. Iceton'
notes: Glossy oval leaves, yellow midrib, yellow speckling. Pink/rose blush on new growth is natural coloring, not damage. Only one Croton total.

name: Fittonia (Nerve Plant)
notes: Pink/magenta netted veining. Currently stressed from a recent lighting change — flagged for follow-up.

name: Coleus 'Under The Sea Pink Reef'
notes: Dark burgundy/pink ruffled leaves, kept indoors year-round.

name: Aglaonema pictum tricolor
notes: Camo-pattern, dark green with light blotching.

name: Tradescantia zebrina (Plant Room)
notes: Recently transplanted from water to soil — rough look likely transplant + move stress, not a separate problem.

name: Jade Jewel Dracaena
notes: Strappy rosette, dark green with white striping.

name: Calathea 'Dottie'
notes: Dark near-black leaf, hot pink feathered midrib. May prefer filtered/distilled water.

name: Peacock Calathea
notes: Dark maroon leaf, pale green feathered pattern. May prefer filtered/distilled water.

name: Ctenanthe (Never-Never Plant)
notes: Elongated lance leaves, irregular yellow-green streaking. Some yellowing/browning at leaf base, likely move-stress — flagged for review.

name: Spider Plant (wire shelf)
notes: Blue textured pot.

name: Spider Plant (ladder shelf)
notes: Gold/brass pot.

name: Golden Pothos (floor)
notes: Black pot, near the wooden ladder shelf.

name: Syngonium (wire shelf)
notes: Silvery variegated, several stems in one pot.

name: Syngonium (second)
notes: Smaller, similar variegation, likely same batch.

name: Phalaenopsis Orchid
notes: Bark substrate, not soil. Water by soaking roots briefly then letting dry, rather than top-inch rule. Bright indirect light, no direct sun.

name: ZZ Plant
notes: Glossy dark paired leaflets, thick fleshy stems. Very drought- and low-light-tolerant.

name: Prayer Plant (Maranta)
notes: Likely 'Kerchoveana'/Rabbit Tracks. Tends to visibly droop when thirsty.

name: Nanouk Tradescantia
notes: Pink/lavender and green striped, propagation stand.

name: Tradescantia cuttings (mixed)
notes: Multiple cuttings, propagation stand — mix of striped silver-green and darker solid-purple, all Tradescantia.

name: Bare-stem Monstera cutting
notes: No leaves yet, sitting directly under the grow lights.

name: Unidentified seedling
notes: Tiny seedling, fuzzy round leaves.
